profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Meta
profile.summary: San Francisco based Software Engineering Manager at Meta

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer, Privacy Area Tech Lead
positions.description: Privacy Area Tech Lead on AI Risk team. Our team embeds privacy, integrity, security, and compliance into Meta's AI models and AI powered products.

positions.title: Software Engineering Manager
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · On-site
positions.description: Leads two 6-person Software Engineering teams, Mobile Testing Frameworks and Jest E2E, who build and support large swaths of test infrastructure used by Meta's mobile and desktop apps - everything from WhatsApp for iOS to facebook.com to Instagram for Android.

positions.title: Software Engineering Manager
positions.description:
Leads 10-person team of engineers, data scientists and designers on the Recruiting Scheduling team. Together, we own internal-only products for Meta employees and candidates to train for interviews, schedule, and be evaluated. 

Our team developed Meta's first entirely autonomous interview scheduling system. This product is an end-to-end product which connects Meta candidates and interviewers directly, automating the recruiting process and putting candidates in the driver's seat.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Tech Lead
positions.description:
Full-stack senior software engineer and tech lead at Facebook working on a suite of internal tools that automate Facebook's recruiting process from candidate sourcing and interview matching to offer generation. 

These internal tools are primarily written with PHP (Hack) backends and React JavaScript frontends that use state management systems like Redux and Undux, as well as GraphQL and client frameworks like Relay. Our tools fall under Enterprise Engineering - they help recruiters and coordinators source candidates, match candidates with prospective interviewers, generate offers, and more. 

While at Facebook, I've also had the opportunity to be an Intern Director - where I helped evaluate and oversee Facebook's intern programs, as well as SEV Review Leader for our org.

positions.title: iOS Developer
positions.description:
iOS start up, Give Drops. Give Drops is an iOS and web app that allows users round up debit/credit purchases and donate the spare change to a charity of your choice.

I was one of two mobile engineers who built the first and second versions of the Drops app for iOS.  We built a fully functional Swift app compatible for iOS 8+ that included features like viewing debit and credit card transaction history, updating payment information and preferences, learning more about their selected charity, selecting a new beneficiary, sharing the app with friends, etc.

positions.title: Course Producer for CSCI 201 (Principles of Software Development)
positions.description: Ran office hours to answer students' questions and help build students' project portfolios, taught interactive labs, graded submitted homework/exams, helped officiate lecture, etc.

positions.title: Co-Author & Undergraduate Researcher for Teamcore Research Group
positions.locationName: USC Viterbi School of Engineering's Department of Computer Science
positions.description:
“Game Theory for Security” develops projects like IRIS (for the Federal Air Marshall’s Service) and PAWS (for the World Wildlife Fund) that develop tailored randomization algorithms and software platforms for international organizations. My personal work includes developing multiple game theoretic algorithms and translating these algorithms to Java. Co-author of AI paper to be submitted to AAAI 2016 (see Base Camp Locator Project below).  

-- AAAI'2016 Best Application of AI video award for "Save the Wildlife, Save the Planet: Protection Assistant for Wildlife Security (PAWS)" (By: Fei Fang, Debarun Kar, Dana Thomas ,Nicole Sintov, Milind Tambe)
--Authored in GameSec 2016: Divide to Defend: Collusive Security Games by Shahrzad Gholami, Bryan Wilder, Matthew Brown, Dana Thomas, Nicole Stinov, and Milind Tambe
--Authored in ECAI 2016: Toward Addressing Collusion among Human Adversaries in Security Games by Shahrzad Gholami, Bryan Wilder, Matthew Brown, Dana Thomas, Nicole Stinov, and Milind Tambe

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Worked throughout the stack on Instagram’s Insights & Interfaces Monetization team. Created new functionality which allows Instagram advertisers to hide comments (built support from Instagram backend all the way to Facebook ads frontend), built UI dialog which enabled new hiding functionality, accessing post information, etc. and created new Facebook notification using pre-existing framework to notify Instagram advertisers of their post’s success. All features built now in production.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Designed and developed new software solutions using Java and PL-SQL for Cisco’s Data Virtualization back-end. Worked on ~5 smaller projects improving performance on preexisting capabilities using regression tests (ex. when software is in use by 100+ concurrent users), improved/debugged Cisco’s web app for Data Virtualization, “Business Directory” (ex. when users create/update LDAP domains), reorganized multithreaded server startup protocol for a more seamless/bug-free server boot, rewrote performance testing scripts, debugged front-end UI errors, etc.

positions.title: Beta & Usability Tester
positions.description: Testing the startup's iOS app by simulating user interaction and detecting/reporting bugs.

honors.title: Senior Design Expo - 1st Place

volunteerExperiences.description: Developing and teaching lesson plans to underprivileged children ages 8 to 15. Activities include learning JavaScript, building robots, working on mathematics homework, etc.

projects.title: Base Camp Locator
projects.description: (Java) Parsed input files detailing the topography of Malaysia to suggest potential campsites to wildlife reserve patrollers. Assigned a utility value to a discretized wildlife reserve map based on variables like proximity to a nearby stream, elevation, etc. Output format was compatible with ArcGIS mapping software so patrollers could use/print grid cells with suggested campsites.

projects.title: Password Attack
projects.description: Creates a database of popular passwords based on permutations of “The 25 Most Common Passwords of 2014”, keywords from past searches, and dictionary attacks.

testScores.name: ACT
testScores.description: National college admittance test, equivalent to the SAT. >99th percentile.
